Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 22 s. 2023 22 2023 LORENZO B. ZUNIGA, JR. Ex-Officio Member Sangguniang Bayan Alaminos, Laguna Dear Hon. Zuniga: This has reference to your letter dated January 19, 2023 requesting guidance on whether or not the Sangguniang Bayan of Alaminos, Laguna possess the plenary powers to legally issue a resolution authorizing the additional amount of Php256.96 per square meter to meet the purchase value of Php600.OO per square meter amending Kapasiyahan Bilang 14 Taong 2022 of the Provincial Assessment Committee. The aforementioned query is based on the following facts stated in your letter: • On August 22, 2022, the Municipal Assessor Eulogio Santillan wrote a letter to the provincial Assessment Committee (Panlalawigang Lupon Tagataya) requesting for the valuation of the properties that the Municipal Government of Alaminos, Laguna intends to procure for the site of a planned Municipal Government Building; On September 8, 2022, the Provincial Assessment Committee sent its authorized personnel and was accompanied by the Municipal Assessor to the location of the properties in Brgy. San Agustin; On October 22, 2022, the Provincial Assessment Committee issued Kapasiyahan Bilang 14 stating therein that the subject properties may be bought by the Municipal Government at a price not exceeding Php343.08 per square meter, more or less; On January 3, 2023, the Municipal Mayor wrote a letter to the Sangguniang Bayan of Alaminos requesting "that an urgent Sangguniang Bayan Resolution be issued providing an additional amount of Php256.92 per square meter to meet the Php600 per square meter purchase value for the properties mentioned in the report." It was important to note that there was no Offer to Buy/Sell was submitted to back up the claim of a purchase value of Php600 per square meter. On January 9, 2023, the request of the Mayor was included in the agenda of the Sanggunian. The Presiding Officer ruled that to return the letter to the Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

requesting party and ask for the legal foundation, i.e. pertinent laws, policy or orders, for such resolution. Hence, your request for guidance. In response to your query, this Department answers in the negative. A mere resolution is not enough considering that the Mayor requested for an additional fund to meet the purchase value of Php600.00. Section 305 (I) of the Local Government Code or Republic Act (R.A.) No. 7160, provides that "No money shall be paid out of the local treasury except in pursuance of an appropriations ordinance or law." Hence, an ordinance should be approved by the Sanggunian. Further, to justify the additional amount, it should be supported by proper documentation and assessment considering that it is almost twice the amount of the valuation made by the Provincial Assessment Committee. The provisions in Chapter Ill of the Manual on Real Property Appraisal and Assessment Operations (the "Manual") issued by the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF) of the Department of Finance (DOF) as of October 1, 2004 may be used as reference. As to the Kapasiyahan Bilang 14 issued by the Provincial Assessor Committee, this Department assumes that it was made pursuant to the assessment they conducted in accordance with the guidelines embodied in the Manual. The appraisal based on the Manual is for the purpose of LGU taxation. The appraisal made may be used by the LGU concerned as basis when they decide to purchase said property. This Department also reminds you that once the LGU decided to purchase said property, the Local Chief Executive should have authorization from the Sangguniang Bayan to represent the municipality in its business transaction as provided in the Local Government Code and that requirements on purchasing the property are complied with, to wit: SECTION 22. Corporate Powers. xxxx (c) Unless otherwise provided in this Code, contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit without prior authorization by the Sanggunian concerned. A legible copy of such contract shall be posted at a conspicuous place in the provincial capitol or the city, municipal or Barangay hall. xxxx SECTION. 444. The Chief Executive: Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. - xxxx Page 2 of 3

b) For efficient, effective and economical govemance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the municipality and its inhabitants pursuant to section 16 of this Code, the municipal mayor shall: (1) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the municipal govemment, and in this connection, shall: (vi) Upon authorization by the Sangguniang Bayan, represent the municipality in all its business transactions and sign on its behalf all bonds, contracts, and obligations, and such other documents made pursuant to law or ordinance; This opinion is being rendered based on the facts provides and without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, n AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ANVI OR R. LLAMAS creta for Extemal, Legal and Legislative Affairs LLA/JVRL/LLLS/OD/518 DIR. ARIEL O.
